scope: Offline frozen-checkpoint evaluation. No retraining, threshold tuning, promotion, notification or live execution changes.

static_validation.zero_positive_pool_ap: not_applicable; report negative image alarm counts

replay.window_selection: Three most frequent visible lengths in TRAIN only, frozen before new model outputs; identical windows and pixels for old/new.
replay.geometry: full edge candles,HL2 SMA/EMA20/60/120,1280x742,visible-only scaling;1200+ known warmup
replay.continuous_selection: All frozen closed day endpoints in existing20-symbol15m/30m/1h snapshot, no fresh ranking or refetch; retrospective same-day gainers selection is not a causal trading universe.
replay.event_cohort: All333 retained positive P9 val/test events, chronological split retained; retrospective rule candidates, not human onset gold.
replay.valid_first_hit: same-class 2D IoU>=0.5 at or after frozen earliest visible launch post. Earlier hits reported separately, not credited as causally warranted launch.
replay.unmatched_continuous_boxes: unadjudicated raw alarms, not automatically false positives
replay.negative_validation: Frozen P9 empty labels plus separately listed Grade-A challenge, not global market negatives
replay.null_control: Train-only median box templates by visible length, fixed majority positive class, applied to every heldout image including negatives; geometry control, not tradable strategy.
